WizardProfile.title: WizardProfile
WizardProfile.description: Player-created wizarding character profile, custom diary lock spell hash, and duel statistics.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the character owner.

wandCore.description: Core material inside the character's wand.

wandWood.description: Wood type of the character's wand.

spellLockHash.description: Salted SHA-256 hex digest of the custom diary lock spell password.

spellLockSalt.description: Hex salt used for hashing and deriving the diary key.

spellLockHint.description: Optional reminder hint for the custom lock spell.

umbridgeDefeatedCount.description: Number of times Professor Umbridge has been defeated.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the wizard profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the wizard profile was last updated.

DiaryEntry.title: DiaryEntry
DiaryEntry.description: A secret manuscript entry stored in the wizard's enchanted diary.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the diary owner.

content.description: AES-GCM encrypted ciphertext or plain manuscript text.

isEncrypted.description: Whether content is encrypted with the custom diary spell password.

iv.description: Base64 initialization vector for AES-GCM decryption.

fontFamily.description: Selected manuscript typeface for this entry.

inputMode.description: Whether the entry was typed, mouse-handwritten, or mixed.

moodTag.description: Short thematic mood or category label.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last entry edit.

ScrollQuery.title: ScrollQuery
ScrollQuery.description: Archived question-and-answer scroll from the Arcane Scroll Oracle.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the scroll owner.

question.description: The question inscribed on the scroll.

answer.description: The oracle's response from diary secrets or web lookup.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the scroll was inscribed.

/wizards/{userId}.description: Primary wizard character profile, custom spell lock hash, and duel records owned by userId.

/wizards/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Cloud-synced secret diary entries belonging to userId.

/wizards/{userId}/scrollQueries/{queryId.description: Saved Arcane Scroll Q&A records belonging to userId.
